contribution.position: Holding my earlier position: on reliability the change is not ready. artifact:perf-report shows a 3.4% peak-load error rate against a 1% budget (3.4x overshoot), and the QA claim of 0.4% does not match that artifact — the discrepancy itself needs resolving. The clean test report (412 passed, 87% coverage) covers functional correctness but evidently not peak-load behavior, and artifact:incident-log's two sev2 retry-storm incidents last quarter show this failure mode is real, not theoretical.
